items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And George, the judge then, Fred. [INTERVIEWER] You told me about the people, this lady that you worked for at Tulane or Newcomb College.

ctx.x: Yes. We'll have to play this for him. He'll enjoy hearing about the family. You probably know things that nobody else remembers.
Well, you know Miss King was a Miss Miller.
